rationale: The system incorrectly traversed the 'CAN_PRECEDE' relationship in the wrong direction, identifying patterns that CAPEC-561 precedes rather than those that precede it. As a result, it failed to identify any of the expected ATT&CK techniques (T1056.001, T1078.001, T1110.001, T1110.002, T1110.003, T1135).
